Enable.description: Whether to enable the sanitization service

ProductionOverride.description: Allow sanitization to run when the environment is Production. Use with extreme caution.

DryRun.description: When true, the built-in user and member sanitisers only log the records they would affect and make no changes. Also allowed to run in Production for a safe preview.

Replacement.description: Templates used by the default personal data replacer. {index} is replaced with a unique number per record.

EmailTemplate.description: Template for replacement email addresses, e.g. user{index}@example.com

NameTemplate.description: Template for replacement names, e.g. user{index}

UserNameTemplate.description: Template for replacement usernames, e.g. user{index}

AiReplacement.description: Settings for the optional Umbraco.Community.Sanitiser.AI replacer.

ProfileAlias.description: Alias of the Umbraco.AI chat profile to use. Leave empty to use the default chat profile.

BatchSize.description: Number of fictional people to request per AI call. Larger batches make fewer, cheaper calls. Minimum 1.

TimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a single AI generation before falling back to templated values, so a slow or hung model cannot block startup. Minimum 1.

Enable.description: Whether to enable sanitization of Umbraco members

DomainsToExclude.description: A comma separated list of domains to exclude from sanitization. Members with email addresses on those domains are excluded. Leave empty to have all members sanitized.

Mode.description: Delete removes members after replacing their personal data; Anonymise replaces their personal data but keeps the records.

Enable.description: Whether to enable sanitization of Umbraco backoffice users

DomainsToExclude.description: A comma separated list of domains to exclude from sanitization. Users with email addresses on those domains are excluded. Leave empty to have all users except the Super Admin sanitized.

Mode.description: Delete removes users after replacing their personal data; Anonymise replaces their personal data but keeps the records.
